_comment: Master item list — everything Carl can pick up or be handed. Carl's actual inventory lives in the save slot, not here. 'type': consumable = gone after one Use; permanent = reusable, may toggle; container = opened later. 'value' is the Safe Room shop SELL price (not wired yet).

items.name: Loot Box
items.description: The System's idea of a participation trophy: a dented, faintly humming cube of alien polymer that drops out of anything worth killing. It refuses to open on command — only when the odds are dramatic and the sponsors are watching. Whatever's inside is scaled to the floor you crack it on: bandages and bent knives down here, worse things later. The System takes its cut of the good stuff first, obviously.
items.tooltip: Loot Box — Use (U) to open it: always some gold (LUCK helps), and a chance at one random item. Consumed on opening.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A fistful of oil-soaked rag on a stick — the crawler's oldest friend. Light it and the dark gives up a little ground: two tiles of sight instead of one. Snuff it to save it. It doesn't burn down, because the System decided realistic torch physics were bad television.
items.tooltipOff: Torch — UNLIT. No effect; sight radius is 1 tile. Use (U) to light it (radius becomes 2). Reusable.
items.tooltipOn: Torch — LIT. Sight radius is 2 tiles. Use (U) to snuff it out (back to 1).

items.name: Small Health Potion
items.description: A thumb-sized vial of something red and faintly carbonated. Tastes like pennies and cough syrup; closes wounds like they were a clerical error. Restores a quarter of Carl's max HP. The System would like to remind you that the Large size is available for purchase.
items.tooltip: Small Health Potion — Use (U) to restore 25% of Max HP. Consumed on use — one and done.

items.name: Dynamite
items.description: A fat red stick of something the System insists is 'legally distinct from dynamite,' with a fuse that burns exactly as long as the drama requires. Lob it in a fight for a flat 2d10 + 10 that armour does nothing about. The crawlspace goblins hoard the stuff; nobody's sure where they get it, and nobody's asking.
items.tooltip: Dynamite — Use (U) in a fight to blast the mob for 2d10 + 10, ignoring armour. Costs your turn; the mob still swings back. One and done.
